# Index of the FLT slice

One line per theorem in `flt-slice.tar.gz`, grouped by the leading namespace of its Lean name: the one-line headline the upstream documentation site gives the theorem, the Lean declaration name, and the module (under `GroupApproximation/ThirdParty/FLT/Theorems/` once the archive is unpacked; its proof is the matching `P2M/Sol/S_*` module). Full statements are in `STATEMENTS.md`; provenance and the map to this repository's lanes are in `UPSTREAM.md`.

1123 theorems in 107 areas.
